instrument: National Code of Practice for Providers of Education and Training to Overseas Students 2018
_comment: Standard NUMBERS and TITLES verified on 2026-09-04. Sub-clause numbering is NOT verified. Every entry below carries workingKnowledge: a working summary used to know what to look for, never to cite. Fetch the instrument and quote the sub-clause before it goes into a policy, a gap row or a finding. Anything cited from workingKnowledge alone must be flagged UNVERIFIED in the gap analysis and listed in the verification report.

requirements.title: Marketing information and practices
requirements.outcome: Marketing to overseas students is accurate, not misleading, and does not overstate outcomes or migration consequences.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Marketing identifies the provider by CRICOS code, does not guarantee a migration outcome, and where an agent markets on the provider's behalf the provider remains responsible for what is said.

requirements.title: Recruitment of an overseas student
requirements.outcome: Recruitment is responsible: the student is genuine, and the course and level are suitable for them.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Assessment of the student's qualifications, experience and English proficiency against course entry requirements, and the Genuine Student requirement.

requirements.title: Formalisation of enrolment and written agreements
requirements.outcome: A written agreement is in place before fees are taken, and it states what the student is buying and what happens if it stops.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Written agreement signed or accepted before the provider receives course money; sets out the course, fees, refund conditions, and the effect of provider or student default; a copy retained for two years after the student ceases to be an accepted student.

requirements.title: Education agents
requirements.outcome: The provider knows what its agents are doing and acts when an agent behaves badly.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Written agreement with every agent; due diligence before appointment; monitoring of agent performance; corrective action or termination where an agent is negligent, incompetent or dishonest; agent details recorded in PRISMS.
requirements.indicator: per-agent visa refusal rate, first-semester withdrawal rate, complaint count

requirements.title: Younger overseas students
requirements.outcome: Students under 18 have approved accommodation, support and welfare arrangements in place for the whole time they need them.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Where the provider approves welfare arrangements it issues a CAAW and the arrangements must run for the period nominated; suitable accommodation, support and general welfare; documented process where arrangements break down; staff with student contact hold the required working-with-children clearance.

requirements.title: Overseas student support services
requirements.outcome: Students are oriented, supported and told who to go to, and staff are competent to do it.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Age- and culture-appropriate orientation; support to help students adjust to study and life in Australia; contact officer or officers; emergency contact number available 24 hours; access to welfare-related support at no additional cost.

requirements.title: Overseas student transfers
requirements.outcome: A restriction on transferring between providers early in the principal course, applied through a published, reasoned assessment.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Documented transfer policy including the grounds on which a release will and will not be granted; a refusal is given in writing with reasons and with the right to appeal; the restriction period attaches to the principal course.
requirements.note: The restriction period changed under the 2024-25 reforms. Verify the current period before writing it into a policy.

requirements.title: Overseas student visa requirements
requirements.outcome: Course progress and attendance are monitored, students at risk are intervened with, and the course is completed within the CoE duration.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Documented course progress policy; intervention triggered at the point of identification, not at the end of term; limits on the proportion of online or distance study; extension of duration only on compassionate or compelling grounds, an approved intervention strategy, or an approved deferral or suspension; reporting through PRISMS where a student breaches.
requirements.indicator: days from at-risk identification to documented intervention; students past the intervention trigger with no record

requirements.title: Deferring, suspending or cancelling the overseas student's enrolment
requirements.outcome: Enrolment is only stopped on defined grounds, and the student gets the chance to appeal first.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Documented grounds for deferral, suspension and cancellation; where the provider initiates it, the student is told in writing of the intention and the right to appeal, and the change is not reported until the internal appeals process is complete or the student stops accessing it.

requirements.title: Complaints and appeals
requirements.outcome: A complaints and appeals process that is free, fast, written down, and does not stop at the provider's front door.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Process commences within a stated period of the complaint being made and is completed within a stated period; written reasons for the outcome; access to an independent external appeal at no or low cost; the student's enrolment is maintained while the process runs.
requirements.indicator: open complaints past their internal timeframe; days to acknowledge; days to written outcome

requirements.title: Additional requirements
requirements.outcome: Changes the Secretary or the ESOS agency must be told about, and records that must be kept.
requirements.workingKnowledge: Notification of changes to the provider's ownership or management and of events affecting the ability to deliver; records of each student's contact details, course progress and payments, kept for the prescribed period and available to the ESOS agency on request.

actLevel.title: Automatic cancellation of CRICOS registration after 12 months without delivery
actLevel.requires: A registered provider, other than an approved school provider, that delivers no course to any overseas student for 12 consecutive months has its registration cancelled automatically. Measurement runs from 1 January 2026.
hardEdges: operates automatically, not by a regulator decision
actLevel.indicator: days since the last overseas-student delivery day, per registered course, per registered location
actLevel.note: This is the single obligation on this list that can end a business without a finding, an audit or a warning. It belongs on the monthly pulse, not the annual calendar.

actLevel.title: Suspension on new CRICOS provider and course applications
actLevel.requires: From 19 May 2026 to 19 May 2027 inclusive, ASQA accepts no new CRICOS registration application from a private VET or ELICOS provider, and no application to add a course to an existing CRICOS registration.
actLevel.note: Not a compliance obligation. It is a planning constraint: any growth plan that assumes a new CRICOS course before 19 May 2027 is not deliverable. Treat it as a strategic risk, not a gap.
